consumer: The external calorie-graphing tool reading the snapshot JSON, asking 'what is the avatar's raw stored calorie value at this tick?'
scope: the avatar's own raw stored_kcal scalar (single ground-truth world-state value), not a derived percent or display view
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_avatar — its body writes ctx.u.get_stored_kcal() straight from the engine getter into the snapshot, holding it as raw state with no predicate evaluation or display formatting
divergence: Two avatar states with identical kcal_percent but different stored_kcal (e.g. different max-kcal capacity): emitting kcal_percent instead of raw stored_kcal would graph them identically while their true calorie totals differ
